final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as specified in their docstrings:

- In bookings/billing.py, I fixed billable_blocks to raise ValueError for negative minutes and to round up partial blocks correctly.
- In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument and instead create a new list on each call.
- In bookings/timeutil.py, I fixed parse_duration to support all the specified duration formats and raise ValueError for unsupported formats.

After these fixes, all tests pass when run with the correct PYTHONPATH. No changes were made to the tests themselves.
